name: Ladies Club Vest
desc:
Our ladies club vest is a nice option for those who like the trimmed, unfinished bottom but not the ragged edges. It is a great option if you want side laces or to put patches on it. This vest comes with or without side laces. The club vest is a flattering style for all shapes and sizes with the princess seam. Made from deerskin, this is a simple but versatile vest.

*This style of Ladies Club Vest is being discontinued, if you're interested, please contact us.

name: Large Rustic Purse
desc:
These purses are all uniquely different. Some with elk hide, or a mix of elk and bison. They are lined with a zipper pocket, most have adjustable straps, and their closures are either a magnetic clasp or snap. The bag can carry almost any tablet up to a Surface Pro.

*Please contact us for our current inventory or custom order requests.

Also, check our Etsy store for immediate purchases.

name: Rustic Purses
desc:
We have them in mixed natural shades, black and brown, as well as solid black. Pockets on both the fronts and back of the purse. The bag has a gusset, giving you more depth to the purse. The strap is either sewn into the bag or attached with an elk horn or metal ring. All three attachments are strong and tested. There is a security snap under the lid as well as the snap you see from the exterior. Bags may be patched and have beads or decoration. Each bag has personality, and there aren't two alike.

Our small rustic purses are made from elk and bison hide. Each bag is unique and unlike any other one. They have multiple pockets and machine stitching around each edge, adding personality and flare. They are unlined and may not be adjustable, however, we are making all new bags with adjustable straps.

*Please contact us for our current inventory, being as it is constantly changing.

Also, check our Etsy store for immediate purchases.

name: Ladies Rustic Vest
desc:
Unique and soft, this vest will make you feel as good as you look! Made of wonderful deerskin, it is soft, breathable, hand washable, and form-fitting. This vest has been our most popular vest for over 25 years. Our rustic style features a longer back and rough edges. Antique beads or semi-precious stones are sewn into a complementing yoke line. Antique nickel snaps close in the front securely. Almost any colors can be combined per special order requests!

This is the wildest, unique vest you will ever find. They are rustic, ragged, scarred, and FULL of character. Each one is just as individual as all of us are. The natural nature of the material may have varied dye lots and surface blemishes. This style features rough-textured hides with holes and scars that are patched with a buck-stitch method.

desc:
Experience luxury this season with our Men's deerskin vest.

Features include:

  • Real Buffalo Nickles
  • Side Laces or Solid
  • 4 Leather Pockets (inside and out)

It is not a flat cut, but has a rounded chest shape for a superior that fits your body. It also comes in a Tall style, giving you 2" extra all the way around the vest.

Features Include:
two inside and two outside pockets, all of which are leather.
This garment is unlined with real buffalo nickle snaps.
It comes in Black and Assorted Browns.

name: Skidmore's Leather Cream
desc:
Skidmore's Leather Cream is an all-natural substance and our recommended leather treatment for our products. This is a USA made product made from plant oils and beeswax for an easy and natural application for a slow conditioning that restores your leathers. The beeswax creates a barrier against dirt, oils and bugs, with no animals oils that go rancid or mineral oil that causes thread rot.

*The wax and moisture may temporarily darken the color of the leather

Use for:

  • Restoring neglected leathers
  • Deep penetrating conditioning
  • Restoring antique and wooden furniture

name: Braided Strap
desc:
These braided deerskin straps are around 40"- 48" long with a "D" ring attached at each end for an easy attaching system for your purse. They come in three colors, black, brown and black, and naturals.

Find out current inventory on our Etsy!

name: Bone Vest Extenders
desc:
Vest extenders are perfect for if you need a little extra room. If you want to wear your vest over your jacket or sweatshirt, no worries, vest extenders are here to help! Our bone vest extenders our hand made with the top-of-the-line jewelry quality beads and materials with steal snaps. We offer them in several color combinations to dress up any vest! We suggest customers purchase the vest extenders in groups of two.

Constructed of the best bone and horn beads, we hand dye and craft them individually and finish them with a deerskin leather tab and cast buffalo nickle.

Features Include:
Real Horn & Bone
Nickle Plated Beads
Heavy Duty Cast Nickle Hardware
Triple Wound Waxed Thread
